assessment: New cell populations of RANK+TLR2- cells and RANK+TLR2+ cells have been identified in RA mice by scRNA-Seq method. The RANK+TLR2- cells could differentiate into a TRAP+ osteoclast lineage but did not fuse to osteoclasts, while RANK+ TLR2+ myeloid monocyte population plays an important role in fusion and osteoclast formation. These findings, with other results, provide novel information on progression of RA disease.
